findings.detail: The Adhefin International subordinated term loan was extracted with blank interest_rate even though the SOI Interest column states EURIBOR + 10.5 % PIK, 14.4 % PIK.

rationale: X02 flags private-credit rows with neither interest_rate nor basis_spread. The bundle includes an Adhefin International subordinated term loan holding with blank interest_rate, but the raw SOI row has explicit PIK interest terms in the Interest column. That makes the missing stored rate an extraction gap, not a source-level absence or a rule false alarm.
